description: Kotlin Benchmark leaderboard, methodology 2: agent-based rows, each with all / open / closed results.

date.description: Publication date: the day this edition went live on kotlinlang.org, not the date of any run.

methodology.description: Methodology version the results were produced with.

tasks.description: Number of tasks in each group; the same for every setup.

setup.description: Normalised setup name, e.g. "Claude Code + Opus 5.5 high".

metrics.description: Results of one setup on one task group. Values are stored without units; a value that isn't ready yet is 0.

resolutionRate.description: Already a percentage, not a fraction.

cost.description: Average cost per task in USD.

latency.description: Average latency per task in minutes.

steps.description: Average number of agent steps for a single task.
